title: 2109 Prairie's veranda turns its corner on columns, as the photograph shows
items: The Roloson house at 2109 Prairie now matches its one photograph. Its veranda stands on round columns on pedestals, turns the south-west corner and runs down the side on open piers, with its railing at the deck and a flat, bare roof.
The rear block steps out only a narrow strip past the front, as the photograph shows. The mansard dormer has its eared hood, and the upper south window sits on the veranda's roof line.
